name: sgs/table-of-contents
title: SGS Table of Contents
description: Auto-generated table of contents from heading blocks. Smooth scroll, scroll spy, collapsible.

wrapper.label: Wrapper
wrapper._note: Single-element block (the <nav> root) — no `layer` declared, so the 12 ARRANGEMENT members are never asked (this block has no grid/flex attrs at all — correct). Typography migrated off the old WP-native supports.typography (fontSize+lineHeight only) onto the shared TypographyControls/sgs_typography_css_rule() mechanism (D971/D972 full-replacement track), root prefix '' (fontSize/fontWeight/fontStyle/lineHeight) — the helper also now offers fontWeight/fontStyle, which native typography never exposed here. No letterSpacing/textTransform/textAlign/fontFamily control is offered, and no width/height/box-shadow/aspect-ratio/max-width attrs exist — honest gaps.

title.label: TOC title
title._note: Only a design-token colour control exists for the title (titleColour) — resolves via default convention (`title`+`Colour`). No independent title font-size/weight/line-height control exists — honest gaps. `titleColourGradient` (2026-09-03) is the text-colour gradient sibling to titleColour, same background-clip:text mechanism as sgs/counter's numberColourGradient.

link.label: TOC link
link._note: `activeLinkColour` styles the scroll-spy-active link (render.php:195 `.sgs-toc__link--active`, toggled by view.js) — a CURRENT state per FR-35-5, declared via explicit `states.current.attrMap` because the naming is a PREFIX (`activeLinkColour`), not the mechanical suffix form, and would otherwise be unreachable by the default convention. No resting-state font-size/weight control exists on the link — honest gap. `linkColourGradient` (2026-09-03) is the text-colour gradient sibling to the RESTING linkColour; `activeLinkColourGradient` is the matching sibling for the CURRENT state, added the same day so the row's SgsColourPanel entry (linkColour normal + activeLinkColour current) can be marked `gradientCapable` as ONE row without leaving the current-state control without a working onGradientChange handler (mirrors sgs/hero's text row, which gives both its normal and hover states their own gradient sibling).

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour.
